scenarios.query: My Bevy game opens to a blank window. Help me debug it with runtime evidence.
expected_behavior: Checks camera, visibility, assets, and schedules

scenarios.query: Add a click handler to this mesh and despawn its children when the player dies.
expected_behavior: Reads the Bevy version from Cargo.lock first

scenarios.query: Upgrade this game from Bevy 0.19 to 0.20.
expected_behavior: Checks that every Bevy-dependent crate has a 0.20 release before bumping
Stops and reports when the physics or networking crate has none
Lists the changes that compile but look different
